parole.testo: Borrowed from English gambit, from Italian gambetto, from gamba, from Late Latin gamba, from Ancient Greek καμπή (kampḗ), from Proto-Indo-European *kh₂emp- (“to bend, curve”) (whence also Polish kępina, Latin campus), from *kh₂em-.

parole.testo: Borrowed from English portfolio, from Italian portafoglio. Doublet of portfel.
